bug.actual_behavior: Pandoc is extracted successfully under two nested version directories, but the wrapper reports that the binary is not found after installation.
evidence: Wrapper reports pandoc binary not found after installation while pandoc.exe exists under pandoc-version/pandoc-version.
bug.expected_behavior: After downloading and extracting Pandoc, the wrapper should locate the executable and continue rendering.
bug.impact: 这是由 skill 设计缺陷导致的真实环境问题，需要纳入后续修复闭环。
reproduction_steps: Run knit_rmd_html.py for an Rmd on Windows without pandoc already on PATH.
Observe the binary under a duplicated version directory and the wrapper failure.
bug.summary: Windows Pandoc bootstrap cannot discover executable extracted into a duplicated version directory
bug.workaround: Prepend the actual nested Pandoc executable directory to PATH before invoking the wrapper.
